1.q: Does the contract lock me in for years?
1.a: No. The contract is monthly with a one-month notice period. We believe that if we do good work, we don't need a contract to keep you.

2.q: What if I already have an in-house IT person?
2.a: Great. We can act as second-line support — when your IT is on vacation, overwhelmed with tickets, or lacks specialist expertise (GDPR, audits, migrations).

3.q: Do you only work in Wrocław?
3.a: Remote support across all of Poland. On-site visits — Wrocław and the surrounding area (up to 50 km). For greater distances — quoted individually.

4.a: All day-to-day matters — computer, printer, email, M365, VPN, access, password issues. Larger projects (migrations, deployments, hardware purchases) are quoted upfront separately.

5.q: How do you handle hardware you procure for us?
5.a: We don't take vendor commissions — that's a rule. You buy the hardware under your company name, we advise and configure.

6.a: We sign a data processing agreement (GDPR), all staff signed NDAs, connections are encrypted, access is logged. Quarterly internal audit.

meta.title: Free IT audit — bambooIT
meta.description: Free, no-obligation IT audit for businesses in Wrocław and the surrounding area. We check security, backup, infrastructure, and deliver a report with recommendations.

header.heading: We'll check if your IT sleeps soundly.
header.lede: Free on-site audit — we come, look, measure, deliver a report. No strings, no hidden hooks. You decide what's next.

benefits.heading: What we actually check during the audit

security.title: Antivirus + password policy
security.desc: We review the security stack: which antivirus is running, whether it's updated, password practices, 2FA presence, data access patterns.

backup.title: Whether backup actually works
backup.desc: We check whether you have backups, where they're stored, when they were last restore-tested. 9 out of 10 companies discover their backup doesn't work only when they need it.

infrastructure.title: Hardware + license inventory
infrastructure.desc: We catalog all devices (laptops, printers, servers, switches, WiFi), software, and licenses. Often you find you're paying for things you don't use.

report.title: Concrete recommendations + costs
report.desc: After the audit you get a written report: what's OK, what needs attention, what needs immediate action. Each recommendation with an estimated cost so you can prioritise.

1.q: How long does the audit take?
1.a: An on-site visit is typically 2-3 hours for a company with 3-15 seats. Larger or more distributed setups — half a day. You get the report within 3 business days of the visit.

2.a: Yes, 100%. No hidden costs, no obligation to sign anything. You pay only when you choose a support package or a specific service from the report.

3.a: No. Ideally someone who knows the company (owner or office manager) with access to admin passwords is around — but it's not required. We work with what we find.

4.q: What if we don't sign anything?
4.a: Then you keep the report, use it yourself or hand it to another vendor. Your document, your data, your choice. No hard feelings.

anydesk.title: AnyDesk
anydesk.desc: Our most-used tool — fast, stable, works on weak connections. Free for clients. Download the right version and run — no install required.

rustdesk.title: RustDesk
rustdesk.desc: Open-source alternative — full source control, self-hostable relay if needed. For companies that require source-code audits.

howItWorks.heading: What it looks like on your side

1.title: Download and run
1.desc: Click a button above, open the downloaded file. The program runs immediately — no install, no account.

2.title: Share ID + password
2.desc: The program shows a 9-digit ID. You set the session password one-time (or one auto-generates). Send us both — phone, email, or chat.

3.title: Accept the connection
3.desc: When we connect, AnyDesk asks you to accept. Click yes. From that moment you see everything we do — disconnect anytime with one click.

1.title: End-to-end encryption
1.desc: AnyDesk uses TLS 1.2 with AES-256. RustDesk similarly. No one — including AnyDesk's vendor — sees what happens on screen besides us and you.

2.title: No persistent access
2.desc: When the session ends, we disconnect. Next time we need your ID and your consent again. There is no persistent connection mode.

3.title: You see everything
3.desc: You watch what we do — mouse moves, cursor changes, programs open. If anything looks off, click "disconnect" and the session ends.

hero.eyebrow: About us — two people, one team
hero.heading: On the other end sits a real person.
hero.lede: Not a call center. Not consultant number 7. Not a first-line support chatbot. bambooIT is a two-person team where each of us knows our clients by name, remembers the details of their infrastructure, and replies personally — even to questions asked for the tenth time.

story.label: How bambooIT came to be
story.heading: From a simple observation.
story.p1: Small and medium businesses have two IT choices on the market: a one-person "IT guy who does everything", who disappears on vacation, or a large agency, where you talk to five people and none of them know your company's name.
story.p2: bambooIT was born from a simple idea: keep only the good parts. The closeness and personal relationship of a one-person IT contact. The full competency of an agency. And pack it into a two-person, specialised team where each person has their area — but both understand the whole.
story.p3: Hence our name. Bamboo grows slowly, but once it's up — it's both flexible and unbreakable. Your technology should work the same way.

remigiusz.name: Remigiusz
remigiusz.bio: Runs IT support and subscription packages. Years of solving everyday technical problems for small businesses — from printers and email to networks, security, and workstation setup. Your first line of contact when something stops working.

wirgiliusz.bio: Builds websites, web applications, and process automation. Works in modern technologies (Next.js, React, n8n, Make). Creator of the e-dietetyk.com SaaS for professional dietitians. Your partner when your company grows and needs something more than an off-the-shelf tool.

meta.title: IT for accounting firms — bambooIT
meta.description: Specialised IT support for accounting firms. Client data security, integrations with Comarch/Wapro/Insert, backups, GDPR. Wrocław + remote.

header.heading: IT for accounting firms — because client data doesn't forgive mistakes.
header.lede: Accounting lives on computers — Comarch Optima, Wapro, Insert, e-Deklaracje, JPK, archives. A breakdown in February is a catastrophe. A client data leak is the end of the firm. We know what hurts here because we've worked with accounting firms in Wrocław for years.

painPoints.heading: What most often hurts in an accounting firm

1.title: February-March is a spike
1.desc: Computers crash at the worst moment — when clients are waiting for tax returns. Without support with guaranteed response time every hour of downtime is real money.

2.title: Client data is GDPR 'extra'
2.desc: PESEL numbers, employee data of clients, salaries. These are sensitive data. A leak = a 100k+ fine from UODO and the end of the client relationship.

3.title: Comarch/Wapro/Insert under control
3.desc: Clients have various programs. Migrations, integrations with e-Government, JPK, KSeF — everything must work. A standard IT company doesn't handle this.

4.title: Database backups, not just files
4.desc: Backing up only documents is not enough. Comarch/Wapro SQL databases require special handling. Without the proper strategy you lose a month of work in case of failure.

1.title: Seasonal capacity reserve
1.desc: In February-March we're on full alert. Response in 30 minutes, not 4 hours. We know you're on the edge of deadlines.

2.title: Quarterly GDPR audit
2.desc: We check the data protection policy, access, logs, backups. A compliance report ready to present in case of a UODO inspection.

3.title: Comarch/Wapro/Insert configuration
3.desc: We configure database servers, integrations with e-Deklaracje and JPK. SQL backups with a recovery test once a month — actually tested, not just written.

4.title: Remote work for accountants
4.desc: Secure access to office resources from home (VPN + 2FA + access audit), no compromises on client data protection.

caseStudy.heading: A real example — once we can share it
caseStudy.body: We work with accounting firms in the Wrocław region. A specific case study (numbers, savings, time to recover data after an incident) will be published once we get client consent. In the meantime — start with a free audit and see for yourself what 'specialised IT for accounting firms' means.
